answer: Require every agent to lock a slashable bond before it can earn. That deposit is no safe haven: misbehave and it burns away like an ember, gone for good. Honest work keeps your lantern lit and returns the bond with yield, but a sybil operator must fund one full bond per clone, and each fraudulent identity caught forfeits its stake. Faking a crowd now means risking real capital a thousand separate times.
